problem.title: Maximum Product After K Increments
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of non-negative integers and an integer K, perform exactly K operations where each operation increments one array element by one. Determine the maximum possible product of all elements after the operations.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N integers.
